info.title: HCC computational core
info.description: Every laboratory behind one contract: describe, run, sweep, validate, export, cancel. No browser, no WebGL, no animation frame. Statuses are load-bearing: NOT_IMPLEMENTED is returned in place of a plausible number, and a synthetic self-test is never reported as an empirical result.

post.description: Superseded by JSON-RPC 2.0 at POST /mcp. Kept working, and every response carries a Deprecation header and a Link to the successor, so a client that already depends on it learns that from the wire rather than from a changelog.

Status.description: EXACT: closed form, or an identity that holds to machine precision by construction | NUMERICALLY_VERIFIED: no closed form, but reproduced by an independent numerical route inside a stated tolerance | CONDITIONAL: exact GIVEN a declared assumption or ansatz that this atlas does not derive | REFERENCE_MODEL: a standard abstract model, useful as a benchmark, NOT a prediction about a physical device | SYNTHETIC_ONLY: exercised only against data this software generated; no external measurement has ever been used | OPEN: the mathematics is stated and the object does not yet exist; no number is returned | NOT_IMPLEMENTED: declared in the catalogue, no computational contract yet; returns no number at all

w_re.description: real part of the rotated point, plane route

w_im.description: imaginary part of the rotated point, plane route

w_sphere_re.description: real part via the sphere route

w_sphere_im.description: imaginary part via the sphere route

route_disagreement.description: chordal distance between the two routes; 0 iff the map is a rigid rotation

cross_ratio_residual.description: change in a test cross-ratio under the map

conformality_residual.description: departure from angle preservation, measured on a small triad

z_re.description: real part of Z at each frequency

z_im.description: imaginary part of Z at each frequency

holdout_fraction.description: contiguous fraction of the band withheld from the fit — blocked, not random, because neighbouring frequency points are not independent

rms_residual_train.description: RMS residual on the fitted points

rms_residual_holdout.description: RMS residual on the band the fit never saw

s_re.description: real part of the transfer parameter

s_im.description: imaginary part of the transfer parameter

bootstrap.description: bootstrap resamples for confidence intervals; 0 disables

n_modes_resolvable.description: number of resolvable modes detected inside the band

modes.description: per-mode f0 (Hz), Q, linewidth (Hz), residue magnitude, participation

order_selected.description: rational order chosen by blocked cross-validation

aic.description: Akaike information criterion at the selected order

bic.description: Bayesian information criterion at the selected order

rms_residual_holdout.description: RMS residual on the blocked hold-out

stable.description: all poles in the left half plane

band_hz.description: the band the claim is restricted to

resolution_hz.description: sample spacing; poles closer than this are not resolvable

bootstrap_intervals.description: per-mode 95% interval on f0 from residual resampling; null when bootstrap = 0

claim.description: the exact, bounded statement this run supports

tune_to_resonance.description: choose C1, C2 so that each loop resonates at f

M_H.description: mutual inductance at this geometry and separation

eta.description: delivered load power divided by real input power

P_in_W.description: real power delivered by the source

power_balance_residual.description: input minus the sum of every sink; must be ~0

U_cmt.description: k sqrt(Q1 Q2) — the ABSTRACT coupled-mode figure of merit

eta_cmt_benchmark.description: U^2/(1+sqrt(1+U^2))^2 — a BENCHMARK, not a device prediction

near_field_ok.description: whether d is small compared with the wavelength

kd.description: 2 pi f d / c — the near-field smallness parameter

N.description: rung index. N = 207 is an INTERNAL reference index near one light-second; it is not recombination and carries no cosmological claim

beta.description: S³ scalar mode index; eigenvalues (beta^2-1)/R^2 with degeneracy beta^2

M.description: cutoff of the DIVERGENT bare sum, displayed rather than hidden

theta.description: reduced temperature k_B T R/(hbar c)

pressure.description: rho/3, the conformal equation of state

Tmode.description: temperature at which k_B T equals the mode half-quantum

Teq.description: temperature at which thermal and zero-point terms are equal

temperature_K.description: the temperature the requested theta corresponds to at this rung

compact.description: 2 G epsilon0/(c^4 R) = phi^(-2N); an algebraic identity, not a quantum black hole

action.description: invariant action cell epsilon0 R/c = hbar/2 at every rung

n.description: how many tau anyons are fused

braid.description: a braid word over 1 (sigma_1), 2 (sigma_2) and a (sigma_1 inverse), acting on the two-dimensional space of three tau with total charge tau

d_tau.description: the quantum dimension phi, the positive root of d^2 = 1 + d

dim_to_tau.description: fusion space dimension in the total-charge-tau sector

dim_to_vacuum.description: fusion space dimension in the vacuum sector

log_dim_rate.description: ln(dim(n)/dim(n-1)), which tends to ln phi — the fusion entropy the recursion operator uses

braid_trace_re.description: real part of the trace of the braid word

braid_trace_im.description: imaginary part of the trace of the braid word

braid_unitarity_residual.description: |B B^dagger - I|, which is zero for a unitary braid representation

yang_baxter_residual.description: worst entry of sigma_1 sigma_2 sigma_1 - sigma_2 sigma_1 sigma_2

central_charge.description: c = 14/5, appearing only on the right-hand side of (ST)^3 and not used to build S or T

u.description: logarithm of the horizon capacity q = N_boundary; u* = ln q* = 282.1114988153041 is the sector the closure selects

lambda.description: the cosmological constant the sector implies

lambda_sigma.description: 1 sigma of the observational inputs, propagated from Omega_L and H0

sigma.description: signed distance of lambda from the measured sky

gamma_slope.description: dGamma/ddelta; zero only at the selected sector

n_phi_rung.description: nearest rung, and whether the sector sits on it within 0.1

bg2.description: the coupling the scheme relation implies at this u

gates.description: the error budget: per gate, the u it implies, its own width, and its distance from the sky in sigma

l_max.description: finite cutoff of the edge-character tower

q.description: the capacity sector the Bradlow projector truncates against

C_APS.description: the O(1) APS defect constant of the naive closure

tau_lP2.description: tau·lP^2; the Planck-cell term forces it to pi

k_CS.description: boundary Chern–Simons level; the lock is k_CS = 2q

zeta_eff.description: the effective zeta(0) of the edge determinant sector. This is the ONE number the missing determinants have to supply; -2/3 is a single massless scalar

D_val.description: an eigenvalue of the valuation operator; the annihilator demands P_val(D) = 0

n_naive.description: root of the naive gap balance — the REFUTED value, reported because the manuscript reports it

n_shell.description: the closed shell the paper claims, quoted for comparison and NOT produced by this operator

C_needed.description: the APS constant the naive balance would need to reach 292 — about 1e61, the answer smuggled in as an input

n_with_determinant.description: the root once a determinant slope is included; null when the slope overshoots ln phi and no positive root exists

kappa.description: the determinant slope -2 zeta_eff(0) ln phi actually supplied

zeta_eff_needed.description: the zeta_eff(0) that would put the root exactly at 292 — a falsifiable target, not a result

scalar_fraction.description: that target in units of one massless scalar — neither nothing nor one field

zeta_eff_species.description: zeta_eff(0) from the literature-fixed edge species content with the full l = 1 vector kernel (6 modes): -8/3

zeta_eff_species_killing.description: the same with the vector kernel read as Killing vectors alone (3 modes): -7/6

n_from_species.description: the root the supplied species content actually gives — null, because its slope overshoots ln phi

species_verdict.description: what the supplied species content decides, in words

spectral_radius.description: largest diagonal entry of R at this cutoff; the operator is diagonal, so this is an eigenvalue and not a bound

levels_kept.description: how many levels survive the Bradlow projector at this q

bradlow_cut.description: the level where l(l+1) > q truncates the tower

violations.description: which admissibility conditions failed, by name

lndet_unit_S2.description: ln det'(-Delta) on the unit two-sphere, exact

kronecker.description: the SL2(Z)-invariant Kronecker term at the declared tau; ONE number once tau is fixed, so it shifts the intercept and cannot move the root

E2.description: E2(tau), quasi-modular, the other argument of F_KL

Z_edge_computed.description: false, always: Z_edge is a declared factorisation and no number is produced for it

selects_292.description: false: the operator as written is a REGISTRY consistent with rung 292, not a selector that produces it

class.description: stationary, periodic, quasiperiodic, chaotic, transient, singular or unreachable
